_meta.description: Clinical trial procedure library built from official CDISC Library API data with standards-based classification
_meta.classificationMethod: CDISC BC categories[0] -> SOA mapping via cdisc_category_mapping.json (no hardcoded keyword dictionaries)
sources: CDISC Library API - Biomedical Concepts (COSMoS v2) - 1,127 BCs with full details
CDISC Library API - SDTM Dataset Specializations - 1,123 specializations across 31 domains
CDISC Library API - SDTMIG v3.4 - 63 domain definitions
CDISC Library API - CDASHIG v2.2 - 35 domain definitions

coreProcedures.name: Urine Dipstick Test
coreProcedures.definition: Use of a test strip designed to detect one or more specific substances in urine. Results are indicated by a color change and may be qualitative or semi-quantitative.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147905 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Glucose Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of glucose present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C105585 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Chemistry Test
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory test designed for the quantification of an organic or inorganic chemical within a biological specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49237 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Urinalysis
coreProcedures.definition: Laboratory analysis of urine, commonly used to aid in the diagnosis of disease or to detect the presence of a specific substance. It involves examination of the urine by physical or chemical means as well as microscopic examination that helps to screen for urinary tract infections, renal disease, and diseases of other organs, that result in abnormal metabolites (break-down products) appearing in the urine.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17241 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Blood Cell Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets in a biospecimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C28133 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Albumin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of albumin present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64431 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Hematology Test
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory test to measure hematopoietic components and investigate hematologic disorders in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49286 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Alanine Aminotransferase Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of alanine aminotransferase present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64433 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Alkaline Phosphatase Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of alkaline phosphatase present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64432 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Leukocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: A test to determine the number of leukocytes in a biospecimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51948 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Creatinine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of creatinine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64547 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Renal Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Absolute Basophil Count
coreProcedures.definition: The total number of white blood cells that are basophils. It is calculated by multiplying the white blood cell count by the percent of basophils in the differential white blood cell count.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64470 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Aspartate Aminotransferase Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of aspartate aminotransferase present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64467 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Sodium Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of sodium present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64809 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Electrolyte Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Hemoglobin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of hemoglobin present in a biospecimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64848 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Electrolyte Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of an electrolyte present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74946 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Potassium Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of potassium present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64853 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Electrolyte Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Waist Circumference
coreProcedures.definition: A circumferential measurement of the waist, which may be classified as the area immediately below the lowest rib, at the narrowest part of the torso, midpoint between the lowest rib and the iliac crest, or immediately above the iliac crest.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C100948 | Categories: Vital Signs, Body Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Liver Function Test
coreProcedures.definition: The quantitative measurement of liver enzymes in the blood, which is useful in assessing the functional state of a patient's liver. Liver function tests include the measurement of albumin, alanine transaminase, aspartate transaminase, alkaline phosphatase, bilirubin, and gamma glutamyl transferase.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74954 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Body Mass Index
coreProcedures.definition: An individual's weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height in meters.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16358 | Categories: Vital Signs, Body Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Body Height
coreProcedures.definition: The vertical measurement or distance from the base to the top of a subject or participant.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C164634 | Categories: Vital Signs, Body Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Body Temperature
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the temperature of the body.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C174446 | Categories: Vital Signs

coreProcedures.name: Systolic Blood Pressure
coreProcedures.definition: The maximum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C25298 | Categories: Vital Signs, Blood Pressure

coreProcedures.name: Diastolic Blood Pressure
coreProcedures.definition: The minimum pressure exerted into the systemic arterial circulation during cardiac ventricular relaxation and filling.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C25299 | Categories: Vital Signs, Blood Pressure

coreProcedures.name: Vital Signs Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The act of assessing an individual's current temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, pulse oxygenation, and blood pressure.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49672 | Categories: Vital Signs

coreProcedures.name: Pulse Rate
coreProcedures.definition: The rate of the pulse as observed in an artery, expressed as beats per minute. It can be measured at several anatomic sites, including the wrist, neck, temple, groin, behind the knees, or on top of the foot.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49676 | Categories: Vital Signs

coreProcedures.name: Respiratory Rate
coreProcedures.definition: The rate of breathing (inhalation and exhalation) measured within in a unit time, usually expressed as breaths per minute.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49678 | Categories: Vital Signs

coreProcedures.name: Heart Rate
coreProcedures.definition: The number of heartbeats per unit of time, usually expressed as beats per minute.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49677 | Categories: Vital Signs

coreProcedures.name: Body Frame Size
coreProcedures.definition: The categorization of a person's body frame into small, medium and large based on the measurement of wrist circumference or the breadth of the elbow.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49680 | Categories: Vital Signs, Body Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Blood Pressure
coreProcedures.definition: The pressure of the circulating blood against the walls of the blood vessels.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C54706 | Categories: Vital Signs, Blood Pressure

coreProcedures.name: Body Weight
coreProcedures.definition: The weight of a subject.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C81328 | Categories: Vital Signs, Body Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Lymphocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of lymphocytes in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51949 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Erythrocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of erythrocytes in a biospecimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51946 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Platelet Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of platelets in a biospecimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51951 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Absolute Neutrophil Count
coreProcedures.definition: The real number of white blood cells (WBC) that are neutrophils. It is derived by multiplying the WBC count by the percent of neutrophils in the differential WBC count. The normal range for ANC is 1.5 to 8.0 (1,500 to 8,000/mm3).
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C63321 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Calcium Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of calcium present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64488 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Carbon Dioxide Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the gas carbon dioxide present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64545 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Gas Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Chloride Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of chloride present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64495 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Electrolyte Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Eosinophil Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of eosinophils in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64550 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Hematocrit Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A measure of the volume of red blood cells expressed as a percentage of the total blood volume. Normal in males is 43-49%, in females 37-43%.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64796 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Urate Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of urate present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64814 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Phosphate Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of phosphate present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64857 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Electrolyte Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Total Protein Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of total protein present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64858 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Protein Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Monocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of monocytes in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64823 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Carbon Monoxide Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of carbon monoxide present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C139084 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Gas Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Bicarbonate Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of bicarbonate present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74667 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Carboxyhemoglobin to Total Hemoglobin Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Carboxyhemoglobin to Total Hemoglobin Ratio Measur
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of carboxyhemoglobin compared to total hemoglobin present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147355 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hemoglobin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Nornicotine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of nornicotine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147406 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Drug Class Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the levels of all members of a specific drug class present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74675 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Nicotine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of nicotine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147403 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Drug Class Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Gas Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the gas in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C82624 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Gas Measurements

coreProcedures.name: CNS Stimulant Drug Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of any drug that stimulates the central nervous system (CNS) present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C75342 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Drug Class Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Cotinine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of cotinine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C92249 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Carboxyhemoglobin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of carboxyhemoglobin present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96591 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hemoglobin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Adverse Event
coreProcedures.definition: Any unfavorable or unintended disease, sign, or symptom (including an abnormal laboratory finding) that is temporally associated with the use of a medical treatment or procedure, and that may or may not be considered related to the medical treatment or procedure. Such events can be related to the intervention, dose, route of administration, patient, or caused by an interaction with another drug(s) or procedure(s).
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C41331 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Biospecimen Collection
coreProcedures.definition: The act or process of gathering biospecimens for testing, diagnostic, propagation, treatment or research purposes.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C70945 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Race
coreProcedures.definition: A geographic ancestral origin category that is assigned to a population group based mainly on physical characteristics that are thought to be distinct and inherent.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17049 | Categories: Demographic Data, Demographics, Population Group

coreProcedures.name: Concomitant Therapy
coreProcedures.definition: Any pharmaceutical agent, other than the primary therapy, that is administered to or used by the subject prior to or during a specified time period.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C53630 | Categories: Interventions, Substance Administration, Medication Administration

coreProcedures.name: Ethnic Group
coreProcedures.definition: A social group characterized by a distinctive social and cultural tradition that is maintained from generation to generation. Members share a common history and origin and a sense of identification with the group. They have similar and distinctive features in their lifestyle habits and shared experiences. They often have a common genetic heritage which may be reflected in their experience of health and disease.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16564 | Categories: Demographic Data, Demographics, Ethnicity

coreProcedures.name: Subject Age
coreProcedures.definition: The age of a person who is the subject in a study.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C69260 | Categories: Demographic Data, Demographics, Personal Attribute

coreProcedures.name: Failure to Meet Randomization Criteria
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that the subject has been unable to fulfill the criteria required for assignment into a randomized group.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C105448 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Sex
coreProcedures.definition: An arbitrary categorization of individuals based on the assemblage of physical properties related to reproduction, and commonly associated with the designation of such categories as female and male. This designation is based on a combination of observable information from organ inventories, morphological assessments, hormone assessments, genetic testing, observed primary and secondary sex characteristics, menstrual status, and/or obstetric history. Current sex designation may or may not be the same as an individual's sex assigned or reported at birth. IMPORTANT NOTICE: The NCI Thesaurus contains biomedical terminologies that NCI does not own or control. This concept contains gender-related content that does not comply with Executive Order 14168.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C28421 | Categories: Demographic Data, Demographics, Personal Attribute

coreProcedures.name: Eligibility Criteria Met By Subject
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that the subject has fulfilled the criteria needed to continue to the next study period.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C132447 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Milestones

coreProcedures.name: Subject is Randomized
coreProcedures.definition: A status indication that a subject is already assigned to an arm of a clinical trial by chance.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C114209 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Milestones

coreProcedures.name: Failure To Meet Continuation Criteria
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that the subject has not been able to meet protocol-defined continuation criteria and will not continue to participate in the clinical trial.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C139236 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Informed Consent
coreProcedures.definition: Consent by a patient to a surgical or medical procedure or participation in a clinical study after achieving an understanding of the relevant medical facts and the risks involved.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16735 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Milestones

coreProcedures.name: Protocol Deviation
coreProcedures.definition: A variation from processes or procedures defined in a protocol. Deviations usually do not preclude the overall evaluability of subject data for either efficacy or safety, and are often acknowledged and accepted in advance by the sponsor. (CDISC Glossary)
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C50996 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Protocol Disposition Event
coreProcedures.definition: The group of incidents that occur during a clinical trial and describe whether a subject completed the study epoch or the reason this event did not occur. The subject's disposition is often described for each phase of the study.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74590 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Protocol Milestone
coreProcedures.definition: Occurrences within some epochs that are initiated by a protocol-specified event. The most common protocol milestone is "Informed Consent Obtained" which usually documents the start of the study.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74588 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Milestones

coreProcedures.name: T-Lymphocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of T-lymphocytes in a biological specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C122157 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Partial Pressure Arterial Oxygen to Fraction Inspired Oxygen Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Partial Pressure Arterial Oxygen to Fraction Inspi
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of the pressure of oxygen dissolved in arterial blood to the percentage oxygen of an inhaled mixture of gasses in a biological specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C119293 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Blood Oxygen Levels

coreProcedures.name: Urea Nitrogen Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of urea nitrogen present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C125949 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Renal Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Choriogonadotropin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of choriogonadotropin present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147128 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hormone Measurements

coreProcedures.name: B-Lymphocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the B-lymphocyte count in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C174314 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Total Bilirubin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The measurement of the total amount of bilirubin present in a particular substrate. The substrate most often tested is blood, but other fluids extracted from the body may be used periodically depending on the purpose of the test.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C38037 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Protein or Enzyme Type Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A term that refers to a chemistry test measuring a specific protein or enzyme in the peripheral blood or body fluid.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64430 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: C-Reactive Protein Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of C-reactive protein present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64548 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Choriogonadotropin Beta Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A determination of the presence of Choriogonadotropin Beta protein.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64851 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hormone Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Lactate Dehydrogenase Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of lactate dehydrogenase present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64855 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Serum HCG Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of human chorionic gonadotropin present in a sample of serum.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C73495 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hormone Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Ferritin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of ferritin present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74737 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Cytokine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of type and amount of cytokines in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74804 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Interleukin 6 Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of interleukin 6 present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74834 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: D-Dimer Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of d-dimers present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C82621 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Natural Killer Cell Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of natural killer cells present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C98762 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Soluble Interleukin-6 Receptor Subunit Alpha Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Soluble Interleukin-6 Receptor Subunit Alpha Measu
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of soluble interleukin 6 receptor subunit alpha present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C200249 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Protein or Enzyme Measurements, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 Antibody Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 An
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 antibody in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C171439 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Virology Tests

coreProcedures.name: SARS-CoV-2 RNA Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of SARS-CoV-2 RNA in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C171531 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Virology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Coronaviridae Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of coronaviridae in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C171456 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Virology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Microbiology Test
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory procedure to detect microorganisms in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49188 | Categories: Microbiology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 Me
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C171532 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Virology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Diagnostic Imaging Testing
coreProcedures.definition: Any method that uses a visual display of structural or functional patterns of organs or tissues for diagnostic evaluation.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16502 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging

coreProcedures.name: Computed Tomography
coreProcedures.definition: A method of examining structures within the body by scanning them with X rays and using a computer to construct a series of cross-sectional scans along a single axis.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17204 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging

coreProcedures.name: X-Ray Imaging
coreProcedures.definition: A radiographic procedure using the emission of x-rays to form an image of the structure penetrated by the radiation.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C38101 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging

coreProcedures.name: Oxygen Saturation Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The measurement of the ratio of oxygenated hemoglobin to total hemoglobin in the blood.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C60832 | Categories: Vital Signs, Oxygen Saturation Measurements, Oximetry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Solicited Adverse Event
coreProcedures.definition: An adverse event that is reported by a healthcare professional, consumer, or patient through an organized data collection system.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C179175 | Categories: Events, Reported Events, Adverse Events

coreProcedures.name: Unsolicited Adverse Event
coreProcedures.definition: An adverse event that is voluntarily reported by a healthcare professional, consumer, or patient outside of an organized data collection system.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C179176 | Categories: Events, Reported Events, Adverse Events

coreProcedures.name: Tissue Culture
coreProcedures.definition: Originally the maintenance and growth of pieces of explanted tissue (plant or animal) in culture away from the source organism. Now usually refers to the (much more frequently used) technique of cell culture, using cells dispersed from tissues or distant descendants of such cells.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17201 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Thawed Specimen
coreProcedures.definition: A specimen that has changed from a frozen to a liquid or semi-liquid state.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C158280 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Quick Freeze
coreProcedures.definition: To freeze rapidly so as to preserve structure and prevent ice crystal formation.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C63521 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Biospecimen Shipping
coreProcedures.definition: The act or process of the logistical considerations for transporting a biological sample from the sender to the receiver.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C179747 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Non-Protocol Disposition Event
coreProcedures.definition: The group of incidents that are not driven by the protocol but that may occur during a clinical trial and describe whether a subject completed the study epoch or the reason this event did not occur.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C150824 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Non-Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Biospecimen Storage
coreProcedures.definition: The act, process and logistical considerations of the physical or environmental conditions under which the biological sample is maintained.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C179748 | Categories: Biospecimen Events

coreProcedures.name: Unblinding
coreProcedures.definition: The process by which identifying information for a patient or group of outcomes from a clinical trial is revealed to the subject and/or investigators conducting the clinical study.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C142742 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Disposition Events, Other Events

coreProcedures.name: Withdrawal of Consent From Protocol-Specified Activity
coreProcedures.shortName: Withdrawal of Consent From Protocol-Specified Acti
coreProcedures.definition: The subject or parent/guardian withdraws their consent for the subject to participate in certain protocol-specified study activities, but does not withdraw consent from participation in the study as a whole.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C170610 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Disposition Events, Other Events

coreProcedures.name: Study Site Transfer
coreProcedures.definition: The study subject has been assigned to a different study site.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C186208 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Disposition Events, Non-Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Electrocardiogram Test
coreProcedures.definition: A character or string that represents the full name of the ECG assessment.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C83146 | Categories: Test Names

coreProcedures.name: 4-(Methylnitrosamino)-1-(3-Pyridyl)-1-Butanol
coreProcedures.definition: The major metabolite of the potentially carcinogenic nitrosamine 4-methylnitrosamino-1,3-pyridyl-1-butanone (nicotine-derived nitrosamine ketone; NNK) that is detected in the urine of subjects exposed to tobacco products. 4-(methylnitrosamino)-1-(3-pyridyl)-1-butanol (nicotine-derived nitrosamine alcohol; NNAL) is produced by carbonyl reduction of NNK and may also be a carcinogen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C127127 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Nitroso Carcinogens, Carcinogenic Nitrosamines

coreProcedures.name: Nitrosonornicotine
coreProcedures.definition: A yellow, oily liquid nitrosamine that solidifies at cold temperatures and emits toxic fumes of nitrogen oxides when heated to decomposition. Nitrosonornicotine is found in tobacco products and is likely produced by the nitrosation of nicotine during the making and smoking of tobacco products. This substance is only used in research to induce tumors in experimental animals. Exposure to nitrosonornicotine affects the liver and nitrosonornicotine is reasonably anticipated to be a human carcinogen. (NCI05)
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C44414 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Nitroso Carcinogens, Carcinogenic Nitrosamines

coreProcedures.name: Carcinogenic Nitrosamine
coreProcedures.definition: An organic N-nitroso compound with possible carcinogenic activity characterized by the group -NNO or -NHNO in its structure, formed by combining nitrates with amines. These compounds are found in various foods and many are carcinogenic or are suspected carcinogens. Cured meats can contain nitrosamines because meats contain amines and can react during cooking with sodium nitrite that is added as a preservative. (NCI05)
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C45398 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Nitroso Carcinogens

coreProcedures.name: Solicited Medical History
coreProcedures.definition: Information about an individual's personal medical history that is reported by a healthcare professional, consumer, or patient through an organized data collection system.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C200145 | Categories: Reported Events, Medical History Events, Medical Conditions

coreProcedures.name: Exposure as Collected Domain
coreProcedures.definition: This interventions domain model reflects protocol-specified study treatment administrations, as collected.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C117466 | Categories: Exposure as Collected

coreProcedures.name: Free Thyroxine Index
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the thyroid status (function, disease diagnosis, or therapy effectiveness) in a biological specimen. This is calculated by a mathematical formula that takes into account the total thyroxine and unbound thyroxine binding globulins.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C170598 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Endocrine Tests

coreProcedures.name: Hemoglobin A1C to Hemoglobin Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Hemoglobin A1C to Hemoglobin Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of the glycosylated hemoglobin compared to total hemoglobin present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C111207 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Hemoglobin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Polychromatic Erythrocytes to Erythrocytes Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Polychromatic Erythrocytes to Erythrocytes Ratio M
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of the polychromatic erythrocytes to total erythrocytes in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C200008 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Erythrocyte Counts

coreProcedures.name: Polychromatic Erythrocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the polychromatic erythrocytes in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C199683 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Microcyte to Erythrocyte Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of microcytes compared to erythrocytes present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C201227 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Erythrocyte Counts

coreProcedures.name: Neutrophil Count
coreProcedures.definition: A test to determine the number of neutrophils in a sample of blood.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51950 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Volume
coreProcedures.definition: The mean cell volume is the average volume of a red blood cell. This is a calculated value derived from the hematocrit and the red cell count.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64799 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin
coreProcedures.definition: The mean cell hemoglobin (MCH), which is the average amount of hemoglobin in the average red cell. The MCH is a calculated value derived from the measurement of hemoglobin and the red cell count.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64797 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Erythrocyte Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration
coreProcedures.definition: The mean cell hemoglobin concentration (MCHC), which is the average concentration of hemoglobin in a given volume of blood. The MCHC is a calculated value derived from the measurement of hemoglobin and the hematocrit.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64798 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Thyrotropin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of thyrotropin present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64813 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Protein or Riboprotein Complexes

coreProcedures.name: Polychromasia
coreProcedures.definition: The reaction of red cells to stain as indicated by the appearance of bluish or grayish colored erythrocytes.
cdiscCategories: Abnormal Blood Chemistry and Hematology Test Results
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64803 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Abnormal Blood Chemistry and Hematology Test Results

coreProcedures.name: Microcyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of microcytes in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64822 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Macrocyte Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of macrocytes in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64821 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Vitamin B12 Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of vitamin B12 present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64817 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Vitamin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Neutrophil Band Form Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of band neutrophils in a blood sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64830 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Neutrophil to Leukocyte Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of neutrophils compared to leukocytes present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64827 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Neutrophil Band Form to Leukocyte Ratio
coreProcedures.shortName: Neutrophil Band Form to Leukocyte Ratio
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of band neutrophils compared to leukocytes in a blood sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64831 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Hemoglobin A1C Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of hemoglobin A1C present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64849 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Hemoglobin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Gamma Glutamyl Transpeptidase Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of gamma glutamyl transpeptidase present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64847 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Liver Function Tests

coreProcedures.name: Folic Acid Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of folic acid present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74676 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Vitamin Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Hormone Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of hormone present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74742 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Endocrine Tests

coreProcedures.name: Blood Cell Count Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of one blood cell component to another in a blood sample. The measurement may be expressed as either a ratio or a percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C67208 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Triiodothyronine Uptake Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the binding of triiodothyonine to thyroxine binding globulin protein in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74748 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Endocrine Tests

coreProcedures.name: Triiodothyronine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of free and bound triiodothyronine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74747 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Endocrine Tests

coreProcedures.name: Free Thyroxine Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of free thyroxine present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74786 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Endocrine Tests

coreProcedures.name: Vitamin Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the type and amount of vitamins in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74803 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Anisocyte Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of anisocytes present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74797 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Peptide Hormone Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of any peptide hormone present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C75385 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Gene Products

coreProcedures.name: Poikilocyte Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the number of poikilocytes present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C79602 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Segmented Neutrophil Count
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of segmented neutrophils present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C81997 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Segmented Neutrophil to Leukocyte Ratio Measurement
coreProcedures.shortName: Segmented Neutrophil to Leukocyte Ratio Measuremen
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the ratio of segmented neutrophils compared to leukocytes present in a sample. The measurement may be expressed as a ratio or percentage.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C82045 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Hematology Tests, Blood Cell Counts

coreProcedures.name: Treponema pallidum Antibody Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of Treponema pallidum antibody in a biological sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C132388 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Immunology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Gram Negative Bacteria Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the gram-negative bacteria present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C154812 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Immunology Test
coreProcedures.definition: Laboratory test involving interaction of antigens with specific antibodies.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16723 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Treponema pallidum Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of Treponema pallidum in a biological sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C184647 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Serology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Treponema pallidum DNA Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of Treponema pallidum DNA present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C198341 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Microbiology Tests, Immunology Tests

coreProcedures.name: Pregnant Subject
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that the study subject is pregnant.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C191656 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Complete
coreProcedures.definition: To possess every necessary or normal part or component or step; having come or been brought to a conclusion.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C25250 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Dead
coreProcedures.definition: The cessation of life.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C28554 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Progressive Disease
coreProcedures.definition: A clinical, pathologic, and/or molecular finding indicating that the course of a disease is worsening in terms of extent or severity.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C35571 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Lost To Follow-Up
coreProcedures.definition: The loss or lack of continuation of subject participation after a study has officially closed.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C48227 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Lack of Efficacy
coreProcedures.definition: The lack of expected or desired effect related to a therapy.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C48226 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Physician Decision
coreProcedures.definition: A position, opinion or judgment reached after consideration by a physician with reference to subject.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C48250 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Withdrawal by Subject
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that a study participant has removed themself from the study or from one or more segments of the study.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49634 | Categories: Subject Disposition, Protocol Disposition Events

coreProcedures.name: Clinical Trial Eligibility Criteria
coreProcedures.definition: Characteristics which are necessary to allow a subject to participate in a clinical study, as outlined in the study protocol. The concept covers inclusion and exclusion criteria.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16112 | Categories: Eligibility Criteria, Clinical Trial Design

coreProcedures.name: Study Product Administration
coreProcedures.definition: The act of the dispensing, applying, or tendering a study product to the participant.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C177924 | Categories: Exposure Reported Name of Treatment

coreProcedures.name: Exclusion Criteria
coreProcedures.definition: Medical and/or social characteristics that prevent a subject from being allowed to participate in a clinical study, as outlined in the study protocol.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C25370 | Categories: Eligibility Criteria, Inclusion Exclusion Criteria

coreProcedures.name: Macroscopic Blood Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount or presence of macroscopic blood present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C147390 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Inclusion Criteria
coreProcedures.definition: Medical and/or social characteristics which are necessary for a subject to be allowed to participate in a clinical study, as outlined in the study protocol. Meeting inclusion criteria is not a sufficient condition for entry or recruitment of a subject into the study. Characteristics limiting the eligibility of a subject for the clinical study must be considered.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C25532 | Categories: Eligibility Criteria, Inclusion Exclusion Criteria

coreProcedures.name: pH
coreProcedures.definition: Quantity of dimension one used to express on a scale from 0 to 14 the amount-of-substance concentration of hydrogen ion of dilute aqueous solution, calculated as the logarithm of the reciprocal of hydrogen-ion concentration in gram atoms per liter.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C45997 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Urinalysis

coreProcedures.name: Nitrite Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of nitrite present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64810 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Urobilinogen Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of urobilinogen present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64816 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Color Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: A qualitative assessment of the color of a biological specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64546 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Urinalysis, Urinary System Findings

coreProcedures.name: Specific Gravity
coreProcedures.definition: The density (mass per unit volume) of any material divided by that of water at a standard temperature.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64832 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Urinalysis, Assay

coreProcedures.name: Ketone Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative measurement of the amount of ketones present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C64854 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Occult Blood Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the blood in body products such as a urine or stool sample, not detectable on gross examination.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C74686 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests

coreProcedures.name: Magnetic Resonance Imaging
coreProcedures.definition: Imaging that uses radiofrequency waves and a strong magnetic field rather than x-rays to provide detailed pictures of internal organs and tissues. The technique is valuable for the diagnosis of many pathologic conditions, including cancer, heart and vascular disease, stroke, and joint and musculoskeletal disorders.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16809 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging

coreProcedures.name: Education Level
coreProcedures.definition: An indication of the years of schooling completed in graded public, private, or parochial schools, and in colleges, universities, or professional schools.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17953 | Categories: Subject Characteristics, Socioeconomic Factors, Socioeconomic Status

coreProcedures.name: Number of Years of Education
coreProcedures.definition: The number of education years that a subject has competed.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C122393 | Categories: Subject Characteristics, Socioeconomic Factors, Socioeconomic Status

coreProcedures.name: History of Tobacco Use
coreProcedures.definition: A description of an individual's current or previous use of tobacco.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181760 | Categories: Substance Use, Personal Medical History, Medical History

coreProcedures.name: Caffeine Use History
coreProcedures.definition: A description of an individual's current or previous caffeine consumption.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C201990 | Categories: Substance Use, Personal Medical History, Medical History

coreProcedures.name: Alcohol Use History
coreProcedures.definition: A description of an individual's current and past experience with alcoholic beverage consumption.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C81229 | Categories: Substance Use, Personal Medical History, Medical History

coreProcedures.name: Secondary Cause of Death
coreProcedures.definition: The second significant event which ultimately led to death.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C116142 | Categories: Death Diagnosis and Details, Cause of Death

coreProcedures.name: Location of Death
coreProcedures.definition: The physical place at which the subject ceased to live.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C124331 | Categories: Death Diagnosis and Details, Location

coreProcedures.name: Age at Death
coreProcedures.definition: The age at which death occurred.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135383 | Categories: Death Diagnosis and Details, Age

coreProcedures.name: Information Source for Cause of Death
coreProcedures.shortName: Information Source for Cause of Death
coreProcedures.definition: The authoritative source that provided the cause of death information.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C176287 | Categories: Death Diagnosis and Details, Source

coreProcedures.name: Primary Cause of Death
coreProcedures.definition: The first significant event which ultimately led to death.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C99531 | Categories: Death Diagnosis and Details, Cause of Death

coreProcedures.name: Clot Detection
coreProcedures.definition: Any of several methods used to detect the presence of or quantify the formation of a thrombus in a specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C111095 | Categories: Clot Detection

coreProcedures.name: Clinical Change by Non-Invasive Imaging Procedure
coreProcedures.shortName: Clinical Change by Non-Invasive Imaging Procedure
coreProcedures.definition: Any clinical change to a subject as determined by a non-invasive imaging procedure.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C123443 | Categories: Clinical Test Result

coreProcedures.name: Physical Examination Finding
coreProcedures.definition: The result of an evaluation of the body and its functions using visual inspection, palpation, percussion, or auscultation that is performed to determine the presence, absence, or degree of a condition.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C83119 | Categories: Physical Examination Finding

coreProcedures.name: Transcription
coreProcedures.definition: A genetic process in which single-stranded RNA with base sequence complementary to a region of plus strand DNA is synthesized by DNA-dependent RNA polymerases. Following the binding of RNA polymerase on DNA promoter regions, the RNA product is synthesized in a 5' to 3' direction, elongating RNA along the DNA strand as the polymerase proceeds, accompanied by unwinding and rewinding of the DNA template.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17208 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Gene Expression Process, Transcription Process

coreProcedures.name: Genetic Variation
coreProcedures.definition: Genetic Variation consists of deviation(s) in the nucleotide sequence of the genetic material of an individual from that typical of the group to which the individual belongs, or deviation(s) in the nucleotide sequence of the genetic material of offspring from that of its parents.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17248 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation

coreProcedures.name: Microsatellite Instability Length Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the variability in length of microsatellite sequences.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181332 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Molecular Analysis, Microsatellite Instability Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Single Nucleotide Variation Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the variability in a nucleotide found within a specified position of the genome, when compared to a reference nucleotide.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181331 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Copy Number Variation Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the variability in the number of replicas of a gene within the genome.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181330 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Gene Signature Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the unique pattern of gene expression of one to many genes associated with a normal or abnormal biological process.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181333 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Gene Expression Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Short Variation Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the variability in a short sequence of nucleotides (generally defined as 50 base pairs or less), when compared to a reference sequence.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181334 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Tumor Mutation Burden Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: A quantitative or qualitative assessment of the number of genomic alterations found in genetic material from tumor cells, when compared to a reference sequence.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C181335 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Sequence Rearrangement
coreProcedures.definition: Any product of a process affecting a nucleic acid sequence that results in the gain, loss, inversion, or translocation of nucleic acid.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C189439 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Genetic Variation

coreProcedures.name: Variable Number Tandem Repeats Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the variations in the number of tandem repeat nucleotide sequences, which are end-to-end adjacent copies of a short (2 to 60 nucleotides) DNA sequence.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C189440 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Gene Expression Process
coreProcedures.definition: Any subcellular or molecular event or process specifically, primarily, and directly designed for and involved in the production of mature functional biomolecular products encoded by a gene.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C21049 | Categories: Biochemical Process

coreProcedures.name: Variant Profile Assessment
coreProcedures.definition: An assessment of the unique pattern of sequence variation of one or more loci associated with a normal or abnormal biological process.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C189441 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Transcription Process
coreProcedures.definition: A Transcription Process is any cellular event or activity directly involved in the synthesis a nascent RNA transcript.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C28614 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Gene Expression Process, Transcription Process

coreProcedures.name: Microsatellite Instability Analysis
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory procedure to detect microsatellite instability.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C63331 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Molecular Analysis, Microsatellite Instability Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Gene Expression Analysis
coreProcedures.definition: Procedures that examine how genes are transcribed to produce functional products. These analyses can include the study of factors that influence gene transcription or the determination of the presence, absence or level of expression for one more genes.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C63479 | Categories: Genomic Findings, Gene Expression Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Cholesterol Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of total cholesterol present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C105586 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Lipid Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Low Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: The determination of the amount of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol present in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C105588 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Lipid Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Estrogen Receptor Status
coreProcedures.definition: The estrogen receptor level measured in a primary tumor or in metastases.  There are essentially two distinct forms of breast cancer, one that tends to have an early onset and is characterized by an ER- status, and one that tends to have a late onset and is characterized by an ER+ status.  However, these two variants tend to overlap with respect to age, so it is possible for a young woman to have a "late-onset" form of breast cancer and for an older woman to have an "early-onset" variant of the disease.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16150 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Protein or Enzyme Type Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Positron Emission Tomography
coreProcedures.definition: A technique for measuring the gamma radiation produced by collisions of electrons and positrons (anti-electrons) within living tissue. In positron emission tomography (PET), a subject is given a dose of a positron-emitting radionuclide attached to a metabolically active substance (for example, 2-fluoro-2-deoxy-D-glucose (FDG), which is similar to a naturally occurring sugar, glucose, with the addition of a radioactive fluorine atom). When living tissue containing the positron emitter is bombarded by electrons, gamma radiation produced by collisions of electrons and positrons is detected by a scanner, revealing in fine detail the tissue location of the metabolically-active substance administered.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17007 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Mammography
coreProcedures.definition: A type of radiography used specifically to examine breast tissue. The procedure utilizes a low-dose of x-rays or radiation to generate an image. A mammography exam or mammogram, is used as a screening tool to detect early breast cancer in women experiencing no symptoms and to detect and diagnose breast disease.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C16818 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Breast Cancer Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Ultrasound Imaging
coreProcedures.definition: The use of high-frequency sound waves to generate images of the body.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17230 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Imaging Procedure
coreProcedures.definition: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17369 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Disease-Free Survival
coreProcedures.definition: The length of time after treatment for a specific disease during which a patient survives with no sign of recurrence of the disease.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C17751 | Categories: Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria, Survival

coreProcedures.name: Locally Recurrent Disease
coreProcedures.definition: The return of a disease after a period of remission at the site in which it initially manifested or adjacent to it.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C176551 | Categories: Disease Response, Recurrence

coreProcedures.name: Expression Positive
coreProcedures.definition: An indication that the expression of a gene, transcript or protein has been detected in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C177692 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Immunology Tests, Genetic Testing

coreProcedures.name: Automated Breast Ultrasound
coreProcedures.definition: A method of ultrasonography for secondary breast cancer screening in asymptomatic women with dense breasts. It uses an ultrasound scanner and a transducer device which moves automatically in a scan box. The patient lies in a supine position and automated breast ultrasound is performed in anteroposterior, medial, and lateral views routinely, and in the superior or inferior view additionally in cases of large breasts. The image series is used for 3-dimensional image reconstruction and tumor detection.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C186741 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging

coreProcedures.name: Microarray Analysis
coreProcedures.definition: Analysis using microarray technology (e.g., cDNA arrays to see gene expression or protein microarrays to profile the pattern of proteins).
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C18477 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Molecular Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Hormone Receptor Status
coreProcedures.definition: An indication of the presence or absence of detection of hormone receptor expression in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C188928 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Chemistry Tests, Hormone Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Recurrence Risk Score
coreProcedures.definition: A score that estimates the likelihood that an individual with have a recurrence of a disease.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C190808 | Categories: Diagnostic Tests

coreProcedures.name: Recurrence in Distant Nodes
coreProcedures.definition: A recurrence of disease in distant lymph nodes.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C192424 | Categories: Disease Response, Recurrent Disease

coreProcedures.name: BRCA2 Gene Mutation
coreProcedures.definition: A mutation that is typically a heritable, permanent change in the nucleotide sequence of the BRCA2 gene. Single nucleotide substitutions and small deletions or insertions (1-20 bases) account for the majority of mutations in the BRCA2 gene. Most of these alterations result in a truncated form of the breast cancer type 2 susceptibility protein. Mutations in the BRCA2 gene predispose males to breast cancer.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C19636 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Molecular Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Diagnostic Ultrasound
coreProcedures.definition: Use of ultrasound for imaging for diagnostic purposes.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C19337 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: BRCA1 Gene Mutation
coreProcedures.definition: A mutation that is typically a heritable, permanent change in the nucleotide sequence of the BRCA1 gene. Single nucleotide substitutions and small deletions or insertions (1-20 bases) account for the majority of mutations in the BRCA1 gene. Approximately 75% of these alterations result in a truncated form of the breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein. Mutations in the BRCA1 gene predispose individuals to breast and ovarian cancers.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C19635 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Molecular Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Molecular Analysis
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory procedure that involves the study of tissues, cells, and fluids using techniques to analyze biologically active molecules, including nucleic acids, proteins, lipids and carbohydrates, for the identification of processes, characteristics and abnormalities at the molecular level.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C19770 | Categories: Laboratory Tests, Laboratory Procedures

coreProcedures.name: MammaPrint Index
coreProcedures.definition: A predictive score for breast cancer reoccurrence based on the expression activity of 70 genes. The results are presented as a score between -1 and 1 with negative scores correlating with low risk of reoccurrence and positive scores correlating with high risk of reoccurrence.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C199199 | Categories: Diagnostic Tests, Diagnostic Procedures, Gene Expression Analysis

coreProcedures.name: Endocrine System Finding
coreProcedures.definition: Symptoms, physical examination results, and/or laboratory test results related to the endocrine system.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C36285 | Categories: Endocrine Tests, Hormone Measurements

coreProcedures.name: Morphologic Finding
coreProcedures.definition: A light microscopic finding that describes the cellular characteristics and architectural patterns of cell populations in a tissue sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C35867 | Categories: Histopathology Findings, Microscopic Findings

coreProcedures.name: Progression-free Survival
coreProcedures.definition: The length of time during and after treatment in which a patient is living with a disease that does not get worse. Progression-free survival may be used in a clinical study or trial to help find out how well a new treatment works.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C28234 | Categories: Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria, Survival

coreProcedures.name: Recurrent Disease
coreProcedures.definition: The return of a disease after a period of remission.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C38155 | Categories: Disease Response, Recurrent Disease

coreProcedures.name: Breast Carcinoma
coreProcedures.definition: A carcinoma arising from the breast, most commonly the terminal ductal-lobular unit. It is the most common malignant tumor in females. Risk factors include country of birth, family history, menstrual and reproductive history, fibrocystic disease and epithelial hyperplasia, exogenous estrogens, contraceptive agents, and ionizing radiation. The vast majority of breast carcinomas are adenocarcinomas (ductal or lobular). Breast carcinoma spreads by direct invasion, by the lymphatic route, and by the blood vessel route. The most common site of lymph node involvement is the axilla.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C4872 | Categories: Cancer, Carcinoma

coreProcedures.name: HER2-Positive Breast Carcinoma
coreProcedures.definition: A biologic subset of breast carcinoma defined by high expression of HER2, GRB7, and TRAP100, and by lack of expression of estrogen receptor (ER).
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C53556 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Gene Products

coreProcedures.name: Cell Count
coreProcedures.definition: A procedure to determine the number of cells in a sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C48938 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Oncotype DX Breast Cancer Assay
coreProcedures.definition: A diagnostic assay that quantifies the likelihood of breast cancer recurrence in women with newly diagnosed, early stage breast cancer. In addition to predicting distant disease recurrence, Oncotype DX also assesses the benefit from certain types of chemotherapy. The assay, performed using formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor tissue, analyzes the expression of a panel of 21 genes and the results are provided as a Recurrence Score (0-100). The gene panel was selected and the Recurrence Score calculation was derived through extensive laboratory testing and multiple independent clinical development studies. Oncotype DX is validated for use in breast cancer patients whose disease is newly diagnosed, stage I or II, node-negative, estrogen receptor-positive and who will be treated with tamoxifen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C52159 | Categories: Diagnostic Tests, Diagnostic Assays, Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Lymph Node Biopsy
coreProcedures.definition: A test in which a lymph node or a piece of a lymph node is removed for examination under a microscope for signs of infection or disease such as cancer.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C51900 | Categories: Diagnostic Procedures, Biopsies

coreProcedures.name: HER2/Neu Positive
coreProcedures.definition: A laboratory test result indicating the presence of HER2/Neu in a tissue sample.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C68748 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Gene Products

coreProcedures.name: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Finding
coreProcedures.definition: Triple-negative breast cancer finding is a negative test result that occurs when the cells in the tumor of a breast cancer patient lack the receptors for both estrogen and progesterone and the human epidermal growth factor receptor 2.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C71428 | Categories: Receptor Status

coreProcedures.name: Receptor Status
coreProcedures.definition: Refers to the presence or absence of specific receptor molecules on the surface of a cells in a specimen.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94299 | Categories: Laboratory Tests

coreProcedures.name: Diagnostic Mammography
coreProcedures.definition: Mammography done after suspicious results on a screening mammogram or after other signs of possible breast cancer.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C79416 | Categories: Diagnostic Imaging, Medical Imaging, Breast Cancer Diagnostic Procedures

coreProcedures.name: Genomic Profile
coreProcedures.definition: An analysis of all the genes in an organism or cell type; this includes assays that identify variants, examine gene expression and determine the interactions of genes with each other and with the environment.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94411 | Categories: Genetic Testing, Gene Expression Analysis, Genetic Variation

coreProcedures.name: Musculoskeletal Finding

coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C110937 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding

coreProcedures.name: T-Score
coreProcedures.definition: A method for converting an individual score into a standard form. While similar to a z-score, t-score is used when the conversion is made without knowledge of the population standard deviation and mean.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C120401 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, T-Score

coreProcedures.name: Mass Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the mass of an item of interest.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C112025 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, Mass Measurement

coreProcedures.name: Bone Mineral Density Z-Score
coreProcedures.definition: A statistical score representing the number of standard deviations above or below what is expected for an individual's bone density based on his age, sex, weight, and race. Z-scores are most useful in evaluating low bone density in children, premenopausal women, and men younger than age fifty.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C139217 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, Z-Score

coreProcedures.name: Body Fat Percentage

coreProcedures.name: Appendicular Skeletal Muscle Mass Measurement

coreProcedures.name: Muscle Endurance Measurement
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of a muscle's ability to perform repetitive contractions against a force.
