coreProcedures.name: Beta Angle of the Hip
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the angle formed by the cartilaginous roof to the vertical cortex of the ilium.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C191307 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding

coreProcedures.name: Alpha Angle of the Hip
coreProcedures.definition: A measurement of the angle between the line from the center of the femoral head to the center of the femoral neck at its narrowest point and the line from the center of the femoral head to a point where the distance from the bone to the center of the head is greater than the radius of the cartilage-covered femoral head.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C191306 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding

coreProcedures.name: Bone Mineral Density Test
coreProcedures.definition: A scanning procedure used to measure calcium and other minerals present in bone.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C61545 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, Diagnostic Procedure

coreProcedures.name: Physical Strength
coreProcedures.definition: Degree of intensity or force in regard to a physical activity.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C87802 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, Physical Strength

coreProcedures.name: Z-Score
coreProcedures.definition: A method for converting an individual score into a standard form. The z-score indicates how far and in what direction an item deviates from its distribution's mean, expressed in units of standard deviation. Calculation of a z-score requires knowledge about the population's standard deviation and mean.
coreProcedures.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C68741 | Categories: Musculoskeletal Finding, Z-Score

coreProcedures.name: Number of Renal Veins

coreProcedures.name: Number of Renal Arteries

This functional test contains 6 items and measures the distance an individual is able to walk over a total of six minutes on a hard, flat surface.

coreProcedures.definition: A standardized rating scale developed by John F. Kurtzke in 1983 to measure the level of functioning in people with multiple sclerosis based on a standard neurological examination. The questionnaire contains 7 functional system; pyramidal functions, cerebellar functions, brainstem functions, sensory function, bowel and bladder function, visual function, and cerebral (or mental) functions. The functional system (FS) scores collected from this questionnaire are used in conjunction with observations and information regarding ambulation and the use of assistive devices to rate the EDSS.

coreProcedures.shortName: Karnofsky Performance Status Scale Clinical Classi
coreProcedures.definition: A standardized rating scale originally developed by David A. Karnofsky and Joseph H. Burchenal in 1949 which is used to evaluate the degree to which a patient is functionally impaired. This instrument consists of 3 sections, no special care needed, unable to work, and unable to care for one's self and is completed by a clinician based on their observations. There are a total of eleven levels ranging from 0-100 where 0 indicates that the patient is dead and 100 indicates that the patient is normal.

ONCOLOGY.name: Therapeutic Procedure
ONCOLOGY.definition: Medical care intended to treat or cure a condition or lessen its symptoms. This includes the administration of drugs, surgical procedures, physical or psychotherapy, or the use of therapeutic devices.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C49236 | Categories: Clinical Trial Attribute, Trial Summary, Oncology Standards

ONCOLOGY.name: New Lesion Progression
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the equivocality of disease progression based on a newly identified lesion.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C103420 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Lymph Node State
ONCOLOGY.definition: A condition or state of a lymph node at a particular time.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C124448 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Results, TR

ONCOLOGY.name: Medical Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: The status of a patient or subject with regard to their health or a medical procedure.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C171082 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Disease Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: The molecular/pathological and/or clinical changes that result from treatment. The changes may include eradication of detectable disease, stabilization of disease, or disease progression.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C50995 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Tumor Identification
ONCOLOGY.definition: A diagnostic procedure to localize and characterize a tumor.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94523 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Identification, TU

ONCOLOGY.name: Matted Tumor Mass Present
ONCOLOGY.definition: A finding indicating that two or more tumors have merged to create a single cancerous mass.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94525 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Identification, TU

ONCOLOGY.name: Response in Target Lesion
ONCOLOGY.definition: A qualitative or quantitative measurement of the response of a target lesion(s) to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94534 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Response in Non-Target Lesion
ONCOLOGY.definition: A qualitative or quantitative measurement of the response of a non-target lesion(s) to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94535 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Overall Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the overall response of the disease to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96613 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Longest Perpendicular
ONCOLOGY.definition: The longest possible straight line or plane through a body or figure that is at a right angle to a given line or plane.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96685 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Results, TR

ONCOLOGY.name: Tumor Fragmentation
ONCOLOGY.definition: A finding indicating that a tumor mass has been divided into two or more tumors.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96642 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Identification, TU

ONCOLOGY.name: Longest Diameter
ONCOLOGY.definition: The longest possible length of a straight line passing through the center of a circular or spheroid object that connects two points on the circumference.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96684 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Results, TR

ONCOLOGY.name: Tumor Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: The condition or state of the tumor at a particular time.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C96643 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Tumor/Lesion Results, TR

ONCOLOGY.name: Genetic Variation Analysis
ONCOLOGY.definition: The identification of genetic variation in a biological sample.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C18302 | Categories: Genomics Findings, Genetic Variation Analysis, Oncology Standards

ONCOLOGY.name: Metabolic Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An evaluation of the metabolic response of the disease to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C123623 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Radiologic Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An evaluation of the radiologic response of the disease to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C123627 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Clinical Performance Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the clinical performance, as measured by a rating or scale, as a condition of disease response to therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135478 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Non-Target Enhancing Lesion Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the response to the therapy of the non-target enhancing lesion.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135480 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Non-Target Non-Enhancing Lesion Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the response to the therapy of the non-target non-enhancing lesion.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135481 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Disease Response in Spleen
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the disease response to therapy within the involved spleen.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135482 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Steroid Use Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of steroid usage as a condition of disease response to therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C135483 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Anatomic Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: An assessment of the anatomic response (based on changes in size of anatomic structures) of the disease to the therapy.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C156564 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Substance Use Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: A term used to describe the state or condition of substance use data.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C83430 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Best Overall Response
ONCOLOGY.definition: The most clinically favorable response recorded from the start of the study treatment until the end of treatment.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C94536 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Disease Response, Disease Response Criteria

ONCOLOGY.name: Radiation Therapy
ONCOLOGY.definition: Treatment of a disease by means of exposure of the target or the whole body to radiation. Radiation therapy is often used as part of curative therapy and occasionally as a component of palliative treatment for cancer. Other uses include total body irradiation prior to transplantation.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C15313 | Categories: Oncology Standards, Therapeutic Procedure, Radiation Therapy

ONCOLOGY.name: Cellularity Measurement
ONCOLOGY.definition: The determination of the amount of degree, quality or condition of cells present in a sample.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C111153 | Categories: Tumor Results, Tumor Measurements

ONCOLOGY.name: Tumor Size Measurement
ONCOLOGY.definition: The measurement of the size of a tumor mass either clinically or in a surgically resected specimen.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C106303 | Categories: Tumor Results, Tumor Measurements

ONCOLOGY.name: Percentage of in situ Carcinoma
ONCOLOGY.definition: A relative measurement (percentage) of in situ component present in a carcinoma compared to the entire malignant cellular proliferation.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C123559 | Categories: Disease Response, Tumor Results, Tumor Measurements

ONCOLOGY.name: Surgical Margins Status
ONCOLOGY.definition: The determination of the presence of actual or potential neoplastic tissue which has been left outside the boundary of a resected specimen within the patient.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C123560 | Categories: Tumor Results, Pathology Results

ONCOLOGY.name: Circulating Tumor Cells Positive
ONCOLOGY.definition: An indication that tumor cells have been detected in a peripheral blood sample.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C146691 | Categories: Diagnostic Procedures, Genetic Testing, Laboratory Tests

ONCOLOGY.name: Genetic Testing
ONCOLOGY.definition: The process of isolating and testing the DNA of an embryo or a person to detect the presence of genetic alterations or defects that may predispose to the future development of a disease or disorder.
ONCOLOGY.sourceDetail: CDISC COSMoS BC: C15709 | Categories: Molecular Analysis, Genetic Variation Analysis, Gene Expression Analysis

ONCOLOGY.name: Residual Cancer Burden
ONCOLOGY.definition: An indication of the amount of invasive cancer in breast or lymph node tissue after completion of neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

ONCOLOGY.name: Residual Cancer Burden Index

PSYCHIATRY.name: Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale Clinical Classification
PSYCHIATRY.shortName: Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale Clinical Classificat
PSYCHIATRY.definition: A standardized rating scale developed by M. Hamilton in 1959 which is used to evaluate the severity of an individual's state of neurotic anxiety. This instrument contains 14 questions or types of symptoms associated with anxiety such as fear, mood, insomnia, and somatic symptoms, which is completed during a semi-structured interview. Each symptom is rated on a scale of 0-4 with 0 being none and 4 being the most severe. A score of 0-17 is considered 'mild', while a score of 18-24 is 'mild to moderate' and a score greater than 24 is 'moderate to severe.'

PSYCHIATRY.definition: A standardized rating scale originally developed by Margaret G. Woerner, Salvatore Mannuzza and John M. Kane in 1988 which is used to evaluate the severity of an individual's psychiatric symptoms. This version consists of 18 questions or types of psychiatric symptoms such as depression, anxiety, hallucinations, motor skills, or other unusual behaviors and is completed during a semi-structured interview. Each symptom is rated on a scale of 1-7 or 1-9 with 1 being non-existent and 7 being very severe; 9 represents 'can not be assessed'.
